title: Cloud Hop
description: Steer a bouncy little critter from cloud to cloud and climb from sunny skies to a starry night.
how_to: Hold your finger left or right to steer. Bouncing is automatic!
Pink puff clouds pop after one bounce. Blue ones drift.
Grab stars for bonus points. Rainbow mushrooms and balloons zoom you up!
Steer around sleepy storm clouds, and don't fall!
